questions.prompt: Which leader was known as the Iron Chancellor of Germany?
questions.fact: He introduced state pensions and health insurance, partly to undercut the appeal of socialist parties.

questions.prompt: What is the largest planet in the solar system?
questions.fact: It is more than twice as massive as all the other planets combined, and its Great Red Spot is a centuries-old storm.

questions.prompt: How many minutes are in a professional soccer match, excluding stoppage?
questions.fact: The ball is typically in play for under sixty of them, which is why added time has grown in recent seasons.

questions.prompt: Which TV series is set in a New York apartment shared by Monica and Rachel?
questions.fact: The cast negotiated their salaries collectively rather than individually, which was highly unusual at the time.

questions.prompt: Which country surrounds the microstate of San Marino?
questions.fact: It claims to be the oldest surviving sovereign state, founded by tradition in the year 301.

questions.prompt: Which author created the character Miss Marple?
questions.fact: The character was partly modelled on the author's own grandmother, who she said always expected the worst of people.

questions.prompt: What is the name of the first widely used web browser with a graphical interface?
questions.fact: Its team went on to found Netscape, and its code indirectly underlies Internet Explorer through a licensed descendant.
